sources.entry: Also, Quora, Reddit, you know the drill.

summary.name: Quora
summary.one_liner: Quora is a question-and-answer website where people share knowledge and discuss topics, as described on its homepage.
use_cases: asking questions and getting answers from the community
reading answers on a wide range of topics
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Quora landing and login screen with the tagline "A place to share knowledge and better understand the world." It offers sign-in via Google, Facebook, or email. The page text shows no concrete feature list beyond this. A listing on jaywcjlove/awesome-mac groups it under "Genuine Sites" alongside Reddit. The page also shows a JavaScript-required and "Something went wrong" error message, so the content could not be fully loaded.
notable: Sign-in with Google, Facebook, or email
Multi-language interface (including Kannada and Hindi links)
caveats: Page failed to load fully and requires JavaScript
Requires an account to log in or sign up
